name: Sonic Boom: A Dating Sonamy Sim?!
source:
Following the events of Sonic Boom S2 EP. 44: Sonic the newly appointed delivery boy is led to a house along the water's edge. Greeted by a familiar face with... intentions, he plays along.

He didn't expect to be stuck in a time loop.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Sonicboomdatingsim/756441]Gamejolt[/url]]
translation:
承接《Sonic Boom》第二季第44集的剧情：刚被任命为送货员的索尼克，被引到水边的一栋房子。迎接他的，是一张熟悉的面孔，而且…别有用心。索尼克决定顺着对方。

他没想到，自己会被困进时间循环。

[摘自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Sonicboomdatingsim/756441]Gamejolt[/url]]
